overview:
The top of the table is getting tighter, and the battle for second has changed hands again! Mcginning to believe remains top with 701 points, adding a respectable 48 this week. However, the gap has actually narrowed: DuncanDisorder bounced back with 71 points to climb from 3rd to 2nd, now just 16 points behind the leader. That pushes MattyCashInTheAttic down to 3rd, just one point behind 2nd after scoring 54. Ctrl Alt Defeat delivered the week's standout performance with a huge 82 points, climbing three places into 7th. Brian the lion also made a strong move, rising two places to 11th after collecting 77 points, while Sharonaldo climbed one spot with an excellent 70-point return. Further up, Dragospear's XI and Krusty's Blue Moon each gained a place, leaving the top seven looking increasingly competitive. At the other end, Try Hard FC slipped to 20th, while 79th time lucky remains rooted to the foot of the table. With only 16 points separating first and second, the pressure is firmly on!

The Premier League served up a much livelier weekend, with 30 goals across the ten matches and an eight-goal thriller at Old Trafford. Manchester United and Aston Villa shared a remarkable 4-4 draw, while Nottingham Forest produced one of the shocks of the weekend by beating Manchester City 3-1. Arsenal edged Hull 1-0 to stay top of the Premier League, and Liverpool picked up a valuable 3-1 win away at Crystal Palace. There were also clean-sheet wins for Leeds against Spurs, Brighton against Brentford and Sunderland against Chelsea, with the latter result giving those managers with Chelsea players plenty to think about. Everton beat Coventry 3-1, with Thierno Barry scoring twice, while Bournemouth won 2-1 at Ipswich. Plenty of goals, a few surprise results and some big individual hauls made GW10 a much more entertaining affair for FPL managers - although those relying on Manchester City's defence may have had a rather different experience!
